classification_contract.revision_rule: Every Hub request is bound to the exact 40-hex revision from JDAO-PINSET-1; resolving a repository name or default branch is insufficient.
classification_contract.source_rule: Only original source records in an expressly named inventory-candidate configuration count as source candidates. Repeated registries, normalized views, embeddings, BM25 rows, graph rows, indexes, and adjacency rows are derivatives or overlapping views.
classification_contract.lineage_rule: Rows sharing a source population are counted once per lineage group even when projected into multiple repositories or configurations.
classification_contract.split_rule: The observed Hub split name train is transport metadata and is never an admissible training, validation, or test split.
classification_contract.rights_rule: A dataset-card license is evidence about a declaration, not proof of upstream source rights or transformation rights. Unknown or incomplete rights fail closed.
classification_contract.viewer_rule: Viewer success establishes bounded schema/count observability only. Viewer success does not establish rights, lineage, semantic validity, a local byte-for-byte load, or training admission.
classification_contract.load_rule: Dataset Viewer info and size responses are the bounded load receipts. No arbitrary repository script or trust-remote-code path was executed.
classification_contract.unknown_rule: Unknown cutoffs, jurisdictions, source revisions, producer tool versions, or schema/load evidence remain explicit gaps and cannot be inferred from repository names.

dispositions.quarantine: Retain immutable inventory evidence, deny training, and require the listed gap to be resolved before later admission.
dispositions.reject: Deny use of the broken or corrupt release. A repaired release requires a new exact revision and a new receipt.

classification_contract.file_receipt_algorithm: sha2-256 over compact sorted-key JSON, without a terminal LF, of the ordered Hub siblings array projected to path, blob_id, size, lfs_sha256, and lfs_size; Hub metadata only, not downloaded-byte verification
classification_contract.viewer_receipt_algorithm: sha2-256 over the compact sorted-key JSON response body, without a terminal LF, from the exact-revision datasets-server info or size endpoint

configuration_fields.split: Observed Hub transport split or null when discovery failed/was disabled.
configuration_fields.semantic_role: source_candidate, source_component, source_projection, derivative, index, metadata, artifact, or unknown.
configuration_fields.row_count: Viewer-observed count unless count_source says pinset; null means unknown.
configuration_fields.schema_status: observed only when the exact-revision Viewer info response returned a feature schema.
configuration_fields.viewer_load: pass only when exact-revision Viewer info and size succeeded.
configuration_fields.rights_disposition: Fail-closed rights outcome for that configuration.
configuration_fields.training_admission: Always deny in this launch inventory.

classification_contract.configuration_decision_rule: Each repository configuration_decision applies to every key in configuration_receipts; a field on an individual configuration would override that common decision.

unresolved_evidence: No direct local byte-for-byte load was attempted for the 314,785,190,822 declared LFS bytes.
Producer tool versions, source cutoffs, complete jurisdictions, upstream source revisions, and transformation-rights chains are unknown unless explicitly recorded on a repository row.
Dataset Viewer failures and disabled Viewer states are retained as failures; they were not silently repaired.
Hub Git blob IDs and LFS SHA-256 declarations are metadata identities and are not represented as locally recomputed file hashes.

explicit_nonclaims: This inventory admits no repository or row for proof-grounded training.
The Hub split named train is not a campaign split.
A Viewer pass is not a rights, lineage, proof, semantic, or training qualification.
A dataset-card license is not an independently verified source-rights chain.
Source candidate counts are inventory observations, not proof of completeness or legal authorization.
Derived rows, repeated registries, and historical normalized views are not independent source examples.
MODEL-LEGACY-1 is artifact-only and has no promotion authority.
Unknown evidence remains unknown; repository names and cards are not used to manufacture cutoffs, jurisdictions, or producer versions.
